title: Motor Vehicle Information – Registrar’s decisions and notifications
text:
n 2(1)(j.2) of the Access to Motor Vehicle Information Regulation (AMVIR) was amended on November 26, 2025, by replacing the reference to the Insurance Crime Prevention Bureau with Équité Association.
Accordingly, Registrar’s Decisions: Notification (RDN) 01/2026 amends
Registrar’s Decisions: 04/2020
and notifies the public about the Registrar’s decision to release Information to Équité Association. Équité Association assists the motor vehicles insurance sector to defend against insurance crime. To further reduce insurance fraud and the cost of motor vehicle insurance in Alberta, the Registrar is approving SBF Access for Équité Association. This will permit Équité Association to investigate theft, fraud, possession of stolen property or any other illegal activity, offence or crime related to or associated with motor vehicles.
Registrar’s Decisions: Notification 07/2025 (RDN 07/2025)
